cell_line.evidence: MDA-MB-231 knockdown rescue cells expressing FLAG-EZH2 or FLAG-T367A were washed three times with PBS, harvested, and lysed in Pierce IP Lysis Buffer (#87797) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors (Thermo Scientific #1861281) and immunoprecipitated with anti-FLAG antibody beads (Sigma M8823).
